attempts.summary: Created a systemd-managed service `inventory-worker` on node1 running as dedicated unprivileged user `inventory-worker`, sandboxed with NoNewPrivileges=yes, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=yes, and ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory (plus additional hardening: PrivateTmp, PrivateDevices, capability/syscall restrictions). Verified via nsenter that writes to /etc and /root are blocked (read-only) while writes to /var/lib/inventory succeed. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and running/writing service state, rebooted node1 via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the service came back active/enabled and resumed writing to its confined directory with sandbox properties intact.
